verdict.rationale: Docs confirm llamafile ships GPU acceleration (Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, Vulkan) but there is no documented diagnostic/logging mechanism explaining why GPU fell back to CPU. Hands-on reports directly contradict any claim of clear diagnostics: one user's CUDA compile failed with an 'error limit reached' and it silently defaulted to CPU with no explanation, and another user on a GPU laptop found 'almost all the processing is done on the CPU' and had to ask the community how to force GPU use — indicating silent, unexplained fallback rather than clear diagnostic output. missing for 10: documented error/warning messages identifying GPU init failure reasons, a troubleshooting guide for GPU fallback, and any first-party mention of diagnostic logging for acceleration failures.
